observation: remaining active years, A and B lagged grain / regional full grain capacity bins, annual common ceiling
objective: undiscounted eight-year total grain kg; myopic uses the identical grain measure for the current year only
exploration: uniform joint action at all six common openings; seed from pair seed and 7753; all 13 actions branched per opening
fallback: both policies use joint P0 in unseen or unsupported states; Bellman continuation uses the P0 estimate at sparse observed states and the same-year pooled developer P0 baseline at unseen states; ties use first canonical action
cash_sensitivity: evaluate frozen primary Q and frozen primary myopic with carry_cash=False; no refit
primary_interval_family: two primary comparators x three endpoints (eight-year grain, two post-stop years grain, cumulative actual payment)
fiscal_gain: simultaneous intervals establish higher total grain and no lower post-stop grain with equivalent or demonstrably lower payment, or establish lower payment with no lower total or post-stop grain; both comparators and coverage required for primary Q claim
scope: new independent synthetic paths on the same A/B parameters; no national policy comparison or new empirical fit
